findings.title: [P1] Reinstate tenant validation before permitting document reads
findings.body: When `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant`, this function now still returns `true`. Callers relying on this authorization decision can therefore expose documents across tenant boundaries. Preserve the tenant-equality check rather than granting every read.

findings.title: [P1] Preserve tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body:
For any differing `userTenant` and `documentTenant` values, this function now returns `true`, allowing callers that rely on it to expose documents across tenant boundaries.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Reinstate tenant validation before permitting document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now returns `true` unconditionally. Any request where `userTenant !== documentTenant` is therefore authorized, enabling cross-tenant document disclosure wherever this exported authorization check is used.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
